========================================
Complex types with the complex macro spelling
========================================

double complex z;
float complex w;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration type: (primitive_type) (type_qualifier) declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration type: (primitive_type) (type_qualifier) declarator: (identifier)))

========================================
Complex types with _Complex
========================================

float _Complex w;
long double _Complex q;
_Complex double v;
complex double u;

---

(translation_unit
  (declaration type: (primitive_type) (type_qualifier) declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration type: (sized_type_specifier type: (primitive_type)) (type_qualifier) declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration (type_qualifier) type: (primitive_type) declarator: (identifier))
  (declaration (type_qualifier) type: (primitive_type) declarator: (identifier)))

========================================
Complex type in a typedef and a function parameter
========================================

typedef double complex c;
double complex f(double complex x);

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition type: (primitive_type) (type_qualifier) declarator: (type_identifier))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    (type_qualifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          type: (primitive_type)
          (type_qualifier)
          declarator: (identifier))))))
